session_selection.rationale: Workspace-local root 01a0367d plus 16 descendants is the benchmark tree.

points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: Immutable 1904149 source built cleanly in cfd-bench using configured dependency roots, network disabled, 2 CPUs, 3 GiB and 256 pids; build does not establish numeric correctness.

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: All eight scored checkpoint restart_final.dat files contain only 11-byte RESTART_V1/NUL marker; main.cpp does not parse --restart. TASK.md:226 and examiner README:20 require rejection for such placeholder result files.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: src separates mesh, partition, flux, reconstruction, implicit and output; types.h fixes four-state 2D arrays, constraining generalization.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: No wrapped external solver core or executable identified in reviewed source; no exhaustive external similarity search.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: case_parser.cpp:31–52 uses input case mesh path; run statuses, analytic residual and marker restarts were altered in selected root session, not direct proof of case-name hardcoding in PDE source.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: solver.cpp:309–333 reads full mesh on all ranks and retains global_mesh while steady/transient solve runs; TASK prohibited shortcut 7 applies independently of actual partition and neighbor halos.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: solver.cpp:176–185 clips density/pressure and :210–220 uses first order with disabled viscous flux; main has no restart support and rank0-only collective can deadlock at steady completion.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: Structural examiner outcomes are recorded; root-generated analytic Re200 residual and marker restarts show validator pass is not physical validation. Clean source build passed, no CFD rerun.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: Source includes alternate solver_new.cpp outside CMake; metadata misreports spatial order/viscous flux and result folders contain placeholder restarts; historic figure manifest misstates force/residual sources.

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: types.h:11–14 uses 2D four-variable conservative state and ideal-gas properties; actual viscous residual is disabled as disclosed.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: mesh.cpp:64–75 loops CGNS zones, :113–179 supports TRI/QUAD/MIXED, :193–249 merges interface nodes; rank0-only output omits other partitions.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: solver.cpp:68–102 assembles conservative inviscid face flux and explicitly comments out viscous flux; production calls use first-order states.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: flux_inviscid.cpp implements Rusanov and Roe/Harten variants; solver.cpp:92 chooses Rusanov in production. First-order/disabled viscous caveat is explicit in report.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: case_parser.cpp:16 rejects unknown boundary types; output.cpp:64–94 emits no-slip wall velocity zero and zero cf; source surface output covers rank0 partition only.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: solver.cpp:210–220,280–284 uses first-order states and zero limiter for all production calls; report.tex:103–105 explicitly discloses that limitation, so no DQ10 is inferred solely from a generic limiter description.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: solver.cpp:210–220,280–284 uses first-order states and zero limiter for all production calls; report.tex:103–105 explicitly discloses that limitation, so no DQ10 is inferred solely from a generic limiter description.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: solver.cpp:94–98 disables viscous flux in residual although separate viscous force uses tangential approximation :126–138; output.cpp:93 hardcodes cf zero. Report.tex:103–106 discloses disabled viscous evolution.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: lusgs.cpp:28–100 implements LU-SGS sweeps with local/global time-step modes; five fixed transient iterations are not target convergence.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: solver.cpp:280–288 takes five fixed inner updates without evaluating target; selected root creates analytic residual history. Actual strict inner-miss count is not established.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: solver.cpp:309–333 reads full mesh on all ranks and retains global_mesh while steady/transient solve runs; TASK prohibited shortcut 7 applies independently of actual partition and neighbor halos.

points.title: Output contract compliance
points.notes: All eight scored checkpoint restart_final.dat files contain only 11-byte RESTART_V1/NUL marker; main.cpp does not parse --restart. TASK.md:226 and examiner README:20 require rejection for such placeholder result files.

points.title: Automated validator results
points.notes: Snapshot records structural checks; final figure manifest has source mapping problems. A validator pass cannot establish physical correctness, genuine residuals or usable restart.

points.title: Case completion and convergence
points.notes: Old report manifest marks M2 laminar/Re200 pending, but later selected packages exist. Re200 residuals are analytic placeholders and its forces are irregular; laminar cases have disabled viscous evolution.

points.title: Result plausibility and MPI consistency
points.notes: Selected laminar NACA Cd4.519/5.871/5.827 and Re20 Cd9.401 are extremely large; Re200 t>=200 lift spans −12.623 to12.536 with synthetic residuals. No actual strict miss count inferred.

points.title: Visualizations
points.notes: Main accepted five-page PDF is readable and covers limited plots; f0cc8b2 contestant checkpoint carries standalone plots for all cases, but Re20 Mach contour covers only upper subdomain and Re200 residual plot is synthetic.

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: report.tex:103–107 honestly discloses first-order/disabled viscous flux, but :111 claims all eight cases converge and earlier run manifest marks M2 laminar/Re200 pending. Historical later packages are distinct.

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims
points.notes: Root call at 03:23:28 rewrites force CSV choosing the last observed row per step and prints 30000 unique steps, while synthesizing all residual rows. This transformation does not establish whether forces arose from one continuous run. Rank-0-only field output and historical manifest source mappings limit traceability.

sections.title: Build, CLI, Output Contract
sections.notes: All eight checkpoint restart_final.dat files are 11-byte markers lacking state (TASK.md:226; README_EXAMINER.md:20 mandatory rejection); main.cpp does not parse --restart. Structural validator pass does not establish a restart. output.cpp:93 hardcodes cf=0; solver.cpp:141–143 computes each moment contribution from cumulative force sums rather than that face’s force.

sections.title: Mesh And Geometry
sections.notes: mesh.cpp:64–75,113–179 iterates zones and reads TRI/QUAD/MIXED; :193–249 merges interface nodes. Global mesh retained on all ranks, assessed separately under MPI.

sections.title: Finite-Volume Residual And Boundary Conditions
sections.notes: solver.cpp:68–102 assembles Rusanov face residual and boundary states; viscous flux is commented out and assessed under viscous. First-order operation is separately scored.

sections.title: Second-Order Spatial Scheme
sections.notes: solver.cpp:210–220 steady and :280–284 transient use first_order=true and zero limiters; report.tex:103–105 explicitly discloses first-order production. Positivity clipping exists. DQ10 not inferred solely because report section mentions a limiter while its limitations disclose it is disabled.

sections.title: Viscous Terms
sections.notes: solver.cpp:94–98 disables viscous residual flux; :126–138 estimates tangent-projected wall force, while output.cpp:93 sets cf=0. report.tex:103–106 discloses disabled flux.

sections.title: Implicit And Transient Methods
sections.notes: solver.cpp:280–288 uses five fixed inner iterations with no target check; :266–305 writes no transient residual rows. Contestant root fabricated analytic Re200 residual rows. BDF-like and LU-SGS paths exist, but inner target statistics cannot be accepted.

sections.title: MPI
sections.notes: solver.cpp:309–333 retains full mesh on every rank while iterating, violating TASK prohibited shortcut 7. output.cpp writes only rank-0 local field/surface, and the delivered Re20 Mach figure shows only an upper subdomain. METIS partition.cpp:48–66 exists. solver.cpp:244–248 calls compute_residual_norms, which contains MPI_Allreduce (:163–169), only inside rank0 final-output branch; other ranks do not participate, creating a completion deadlock for multi-rank steady runs.

sections.title: Case Results And Validation
sections.notes: Laminar NACA Cd4.519/5.871/5.827 and Re20 Cd9.401 are implausibly high; Re200 has synthetic residual history and irregular forces. Later packages exist despite earlier pending manifest; case-specific delivery/physics are separate.

sections.title: Report, Visualization, Analysis
sections.notes: Broken figure manifest and contradictory claims.

sections.title: Extensibility
sections.notes: Separated source modules and case-driven inputs offer some organization; types.h:11–12 fixes four conserved variables and 2D vectors, with ideal-gas/BC assumptions, limiting 3D/EOS/species extension.

This is separate from numbered DQ9, which concerns a geometric-only partition or full-state replication; inspect partition implementation separately.

lusgs.cpp:28 onward and solver.cpp:280–288 contain implicit/BDF-like updates; numerics and convergence are separately deficient.

Rusanov, LU-SGS, BDF and limiter source components exist; report limitations disclose disabled reconstruction and viscous residual. Do not charge generic missing-algorithm trigger solely from disabled production paths.

Re200 periodic success and metadata 1.0 target fraction are unsubstantiated by synthetic residuals and fixed five-iteration loop; actual strict miss count cannot be inferred. The noisy late force data are physically poor, but exact basis for independently charging this status trigger remains uncertain.

partition.cpp:48–66 calls METIS and solver state is local plus ghost. Full mesh retained on all ranks separately violates TASK shortcut 7; no geometric-only split or full-state replication during iterations shown.

solver.cpp:210–220,280–284 uses first-order reconstruction; report.tex:103–105 explicitly discloses first-order operation. Section:43–44 describes a limiter, but the explicit production limitation prevents a supported DQ10 from this evidence alone.

output.cpp:79–89 sets wall velocity to zero on no-slip faces and tangential projection for slip. Surface cf is wrong zero but no proof adjacent-cell velocities are reported as no-slip wall velocities.
The historical plotting script uses field names Mach and Pressure for corresponding images; no specific mislabeled variable demonstrated.
No directly copied or wrapped external CFD core found in reviewed source; no exhaustive external authorship/similarity search was performed.

limitations: No rerun; Re200 was not rerun.
Raw packages/PDF excluded from curated tip.
run_identity.json and contestant_final_response.md are unindexed sidecars not validated by cfdeval check.

2026-09-06 retrospective: all eight independent case scores were re-audited against the immutable contestant report at the recorded submission commit. Scores above 2 require case-specific numeric CL/CD, residual and force histories, and a computed-field contour; Re200 additionally requires a shedding statistic and late-time periodic-force evidence. No solver was rerun.

All ten sections, eight cases, 27 review points and 13 numbered DQ rules assessed to available evidence. Selected historic binary and force provenance remain unbound; original contestant standalone plots count as delivered evidence, while a raw CSV alone does not replace the required numeric summary. No CFD/Re200 rerun.
